co-je-naex.skratka.2: Every round, a brawl over one location.
co-je-naex.skratka.3: The game is a deliberately overblown caricature.
co-je-naex.p1:
NA EX! is a card game for two players set in a rough village. Every round you fight over one

location

— the pub, the church, the petrol station. Whoever wins the

brawl

collects

butts

, the dog-ends that keep the score round here. And the

elders

, the village big shots who watched the brawl, start to fear them.
co-je-naex.p2:
You play cards into a shared

line

, buy them with

cigarettes

and drink

shots

as you go. The game is named after one move:

NA EX

— you pour a shot over your opponent's card, down in one.
co-je-naex.p3: The game is fiction and a deliberately exaggerated caricature. We don't recommend alcohol, smoking, gambling or debt to anyone in real life.

sk.skratka.2: Každé kolo bitka o jednu lokalitu.
sk.p1:
NA EX! je kartová hra pre dvoch hráčov zasadená do drsnej dediny. Každé kolo sa bijete o jednu

lokalitu

— krčmu, kostol, benzínku. Kto vyhrá

bitku

, zbiera

špaky

, ohorky, ktorými sa tu ráta. A

starší

, dedinské autority, ktorí bitku videli, sa ho začnú báť.
sk.p2:
Karty hráte do spoločnej

línie

, kupujete ich za

cigarety

a pijete pri tom

poldeci

. Podľa jedného ťahu sa hra volá:

NA EX

— vyleješ poldeci na súperovu kartu, na ex.
sk.p3: Hra je fikcia a zámerne zveličená karikatúra. Alkohol, fajčenie, hazard ani dlhy v skutočnom živote nikomu neodporúčame.

ako-sa-vyhrava.skratka.1: Whoever has more butts at the end wins.
ako-sa-vyhrava.skratka.2: A brawl won: a butt for every card in the line, your opponent's too.
ako-sa-vyhrava.skratka.3: An elder who fears you pays you butts after every brawl you win.
ako-sa-vyhrava.p1:
Butts for the brawl. The winner of the

brawl

gets 1

butt

for every card lying in the

line

at the brawl — yours and your opponent's.
ako-sa-vyhrava.p2:
Butts for fear. However many hits you won the brawl by, that much

fear

you split among the

elders

. Whoever fears you pays you after every further brawl you win — the more they fear, the more they pay.
ako-sa-vyhrava.p3: At the end, whoever has more butts wins. How long the game lasts, when you can win early and how you can lose butts is in the chapter Butts and the finale.

sk.skratka.1: Vyhrá, kto má na konci viac špakov.
sk.skratka.2: Vyhratá bitka: špak za každú kartu v línii, aj za súperove.
sk.skratka.3: Starší, ktorý sa ťa bojí, ti po každej vyhratej bitke platí špaky.
sk.p1:
Špaky za bitku. Víťaz

bitky

dostane 1

špak

za každú kartu, ktorá pri bitke leží v

línii

— tvoje aj súperove.
sk.p2:
Špaky za strach. O koľko úderov si bitku vyhral, toľko

strachu

rozdelíš medzi

starších

. Kto sa ťa bojí, platí ti po každej ďalšej vyhratej bitke — čím viac sa bojí, tým viac.
sk.p3: Na konci vyhrá, kto má viac špakov. Ako dlho hra trvá, kedy sa dá vyhrať skôr a o čo môžeš špaky prísť, je v kapitole Špaky a finále.

co-mas-pred-sebou.skratka.1: Cards in your hand; down by you, shots, cigarettes and butts.
co-mas-pred-sebou.skratka.2: The icons on the edge of a card are actions; Punch, Wallop and Haymaker are hits worth 1, 2 and 3.
co-mas-pred-sebou.skratka.3: An action only counts in a link: when it meets an action of the neighbouring card at the same height.
co-mas-pred-sebou.h.co-mas-pred-sebou-bar: Your hand and what you've got by you
co-mas-pred-sebou.p1:
You have cards in your hand. Down by you, you see your

shots

(full and empty),

cigarettes

and

butts

.
co-mas-pred-sebou.p2:
The icons on the edge of a card are

actions

. Punch, Wallop and Haymaker are hits worth 1, 2 and 3 — whoever has more hits in the brawl wins. An action only counts when it's in a

link

: it touches an action of the neighbouring card at the same height. A lonely action does nothing. What's written on the card is in the chapter Assembly.

sk.skratka.1: Karty v ruke; dole pri sebe poldeci, cigarety a špaky.
sk.skratka.2: Ikony na okraji karty sú akcie; Rana, Pecka a Petelica sú údery za 1, 2 a 3.
sk.skratka.3: Akcia platí len v spoji: keď sa stretne s akciou susednej karty v rovnakej výške.
sk.h.co-mas-pred-sebou-bar: Ruka a čo máš pri sebe
sk.p1:
Máš karty v ruke. Dole pri sebe vidíš svoje

poldeci

(plné a vypité),

cigarety

a

špaky

.
sk.p2:
Ikony na okraji karty sú

akcie

. Rana, Pecka a Petelica sú údery za 1, 2 a 3 — kto má v bitke viac úderov, vyhrá. Akcia platí, len keď je v

spoji

: dotkne sa akcie susednej karty v rovnakej výške. Osamelá akcia nerobí nič. Čo je na karte napísané, je v kapitole Zhromaždenie.

kolo.skratka.2: Every card costs you a full shot — as many full ones as you have, that many cards you play.
kolo.skratka.3: In the Booze-up you may pour a NA EX; in the brawl, more hits wins.
kolo.p6:
Location. A

location

is chosen for you to fight over this round. It lies in the middle of the

line

.
kolo.p7:
Market. You take turns buying cards from the

Market

, one for a

cigarette

.
kolo.p8:
Assembly. You take turns playing cards against the location into the line (the

Assembly

). Every card costs you a full

shot

— as many full ones as you have, that many cards you play. You play so that your actions find a

link

.
kolo.p9:
Booze-up. Time to drink (the

Booze-up

). You may pour a

NA EX

: you pour a full shot over a card in the line and its actions in a link go dark. The Assembly and the Booze-up can repeat within a round.
kolo.p10:
Brawl. The hits are added up and whoever has more has won. The winner gets a butt for every card in the line, and however much they won by, that much

fear

they split among the

elders

.
kolo.p11: In detail, with everything that goes with it, the round is covered in the part A round step by step.

sk.skratka.2: Každá karta ťa stojí plný poldeci — koľko máš plných, toľko kariet zahráš.
sk.skratka.3: V Pitke smieš dať NA EX; v bitke vyhrá viac úderov.
sk.p6:
Lokalita. Vyberie sa

lokalita

, o ktorú sa v kole bijete. Leží v strede

línie

.
sk.p7:
Ponuka. Z

ponuky

kariet si striedavo kupujete karty, jednu za

cigaretu

.
sk.p8:
Zhromaždenie. Striedavo hráte karty k lokalite do línie (

Zhromaždenie

). Každá karta ťa stojí plný

poldeci

— koľko máš plných, toľko kariet zahráš. Hráš tak, aby tvoje akcie našli

spoj

.
sk.p9:
Pitka. Pije sa (

Pitka

). Smieš dať

NA EX

: vyleješ plný poldeci na kartu v línii a jej akcie v spoji zhasnú. Zhromaždenie a Pitka sa za kolo môžu zopakovať.
sk.p10:
Bitka. Sčítajú sa údery a kto má viac, vyhral. Víťaz dostane špak za každú kartu v línii a o koľko vyhral, toľko

strachu

rozdelí medzi

starších

.
sk.p11: Podrobne, so všetkým, čo k tomu patrí, ide kolo v časti Kolo krok za krokom.

ciel-a-senok.nazov: The round, the target and the Market
ciel-a-senok.skratka.1: Round: target → Market → Assembly and Booze-up (1–5×) → brawl → after the brawl; the attacker lost the last brawl, the defender won it.
ciel-a-senok.skratka.2: Start: 4 cards in hand, empty deck, 3 full shots, 3 cigarettes; locations by level (Second Division 1 · 2 · 2 · 3 · 3), then the finale.
ciel-a-senok.skratka.3: The defender chooses the location; the winner of the last argument turns it.
ciel-a-senok.skratka.4: Setting up the Market: half the cards into the Market, half to the bottom of the deck.
ciel-a-senok.skratka.5: Taking in turns: 1 card for 1 cigarette, 2 cards for 3.
ciel-a-senok.skratka.6: Capturing costs 5 points and persuading 3 — after the brawl, when the Thrashing and the argument are split.
ciel-a-senok.p6:
Target. The

defender

(winner of the last brawl) chooses the location; the winner of the last argument turns it.
ciel-a-senok.p7: Market. Together you set up a Market of cards and take from it for cigarettes.
ciel-a-senok.p8: Assembly and Booze-up. You take turns laying cards into the line, then there's drinking and reckoning. It repeats 1 to 5 times depending on the line (5 times only on the pinnacle in the finale).
ciel-a-senok.p9: Brawl. More hard damage wins and gets a butt for every card in the line. The elders score. The winner splits the Thrashing onto their fear; the winner of the argument splits the argument onto their rumours.
ciel-a-senok.p10:
After the brawl. The loser gets 1 cigarette. Your opponent gives you 1 cigarette for every elder with your red fear, prisoners included, as many as they have (

protection money

). After the finale, neither. The cards from the line go to the discard piles. All shots are restored to full (not after the finale), and at the start of the next round each player

draws

2 cards.
ciel-a-senok.p11:
Choose a

division

— the Third Division has 3 locations, the Second 5, the First 7; after them comes the

finale

. Each player starts with 4 starting cards in hand — the Altar Boy, the Loving Wife, the Drunk and the Eligible Lass. The draw pile is empty; only the discard pile fills it, and until then you can neither draw nor smoke. On top of that, 3 full shots, 3 cigarettes and 0 butts. The game deals out 8 elders, each with a random favour; both players' fear and rumours on them start at zero.
ciel-a-senok.p12: The attacker is whoever lost the last brawl: in the Assembly they play first, and they answer revealed NA EX first. The defender chooses the round's target (the winner of the last argument turns it) and takes from the Market first. You both play the Booze-up at the same time; answers to NA EX go face down and flip over at once. In the finale the one behind attacks — whoever has fewer butts.
ciel-a-senok.p13:
The defender chooses the location to be fought over, and the winner of last round's argument

turns

it (in the first round and after a tied argument, whoever chooses). The location lies in the middle of the line and splits it into two

wings

. The facing decides which edge of the location belongs to which wing — the edge's actions go to whoever has the upper hand in that wing. A location's effect applies only in the round when it's fought over (table of locations). In the finale the defender — whoever is ahead — chooses from three pinnacle locations, and it's fought over like any other.
ciel-a-senok.p14:
The Market cards lie in two decks, face down: the

Tools deck

and the

villagers deck

(all the other cards). Cards nobody took from the old Market go to the bottom of their deck. Then each player takes 2 cards from the Tools deck and 6 from the villagers deck. Both at once and in secret, you put 4 into the Market in any mix and the other 4 to the bottom of their deck (your opponent doesn't see them). You pass nothing to each other; the Market has 8 cards. When a deck runs short, the other one makes up the missing cards.
ciel-a-senok.p15: You take turns; the defender starts — on their first go just 1 card, so they don't clean out the Market. Otherwise on your go you take 1 card for 1 cigarette or 2 cards for 3 cigarettes. You don't pay shots for the Market. Once one player stops, the other has only one more go; whoever has no cigarette stops by themselves. Then the Market is topped up to 8 cards — first from the Tools deck until there are at least 2 Tools in it, the rest from the villagers deck. Prisoners don't change the number of cards in the setup.
ciel-a-senok.p16: Capturing and persuading happen after the brawl, when the Thrashing and the argument are split (chapter Elders and the Thrashing). In the finale, neither.
ciel-a-senok.p17:
Capture — whoever is splitting the Thrashing captures, for 5 points, an elder where their fear was already in the red before this Thrashing — that is, since the last round; fear topped up to red in the same split isn't enough. On the table such an elder shows the stamp CAPTURE. You may capture several at once, and you don't have to. The elder is your

prisoner

: they lie among your confessed cards, disappear from the scale, and your opponent hands you as many butts as they have argument points in rumours on them — what their notches of rumours cost (yellow 1, orange 2, red 3) — at most as many as they have. A prisoner counts as red and has an ability. Prisoners needed to win depend on the division — Third 2, Second 3, First 4 — and end the game at once.
ciel-a-senok.p18: Persuasion — whoever is splitting the argument persuades, for 3 points, any elder where they have rumours over the whole thermometer (they may top them up in the same split; on the table, the stamp PERSUADE). Rumours, both players' fear and favour all stay. The elder's card goes into their hand and belongs to their deck for good — it's played as an Elder, actions only; it has no prisoner's ability. First to persuade keeps them; either player may capture a persuaded elder — the card then vanishes from wherever it is into the cellar.

sk.skratka.1: Kolo: cieľ → ponuka → Zhromaždenie a Pitka (1–5×) → bitka → po bitke; útočník prehral poslednú bitku, obranca ju vyhral.
sk.skratka.2: Štart: 4 karty v ruke, prázdny balíček, 3 plné poldeci, 3 cigarety; lokality po úrovniach (Druhá liga 1 · 2 · 2 · 3 · 3), potom finále.
sk.skratka.3: Obranca vyberie lokalitu, víťaz minulej hádky ju natočí.
sk.skratka.4: Stavba ponuky: polovica kariet do ponuky, polovica naspodok balíčka.
sk.skratka.5: Branie striedavo: 1 karta za 1 cigaretu, 2 karty za 3.
sk.skratka.6: Zajíma sa za 5 bodov a presviedča za 3 — po bitke, pri rozdelení Nakladačky a hádky.
sk.p6:
Cieľ.

Obranca

(víťaz poslednej bitky) vyberie lokalitu, natočí ju víťaz minulej hádky.
sk.p7: Ponuka. Spolu postavíte ponuku kariet a beriete z nej za cigarety.
sk.p8: Zhromaždenie a Pitka. Striedavo vykladáte karty do línie, potom sa pije a vyhodnocuje. Opakuje sa 1- až 5-krát podľa línie (5-krát len na pinnacle vo finále).
sk.p9: Bitka. Viac tuhého poškodenia vyhráva a dostane špak za každú kartu v línii. Starší bodujú. Víťaz rozdelí Nakladačku na svoj strach, víťaz hádky hádku na svoje reči.
sk.p10:
Po bitke. Porazený dostane 1 cigaretu. Súper ti dá 1 cigaretu za každého staršieho s tvojím červeným strachom, aj za väzňa, koľko má (

výpalné

). Po finále ani jedno. Karty z línie idú do odhadzovacích balíčkov. Všetky poldeci sa obnovia na plné (po finále nie) a na začiatku ďalšieho kola si každý

dobere

2 karty.
sk.p11:
Zvoľte

ligu

— Tretia liga má 3 lokality, Druhá 5, Prvá 7; po nich príde

finále

. Každý hráč má na začiatku v ruke 4 štartovacie karty — Miňištranta, Milujúcu manželku, Pijana a Dievčinu na vydaj. Doberací balíček je prázdny, naplní ho až odhadzovací; dovtedy sa nedá ťahať ani fajčiť. K tomu 3 plné poldeci, 3 cigarety a 0 špakov. Hra rozdá 8 starších, každému náhodne jeho priazeň; strach aj reči oboch hráčov sú pri nich na nule.
sk.p12: Útočník je ten, kto prehral poslednú bitku: v Zhromaždení vykladá prvý a na odkryté NA EX odpovedá prvý. Obranca vyberá cieľ kola (natáča ho víťaz minulej hádky) a z ponuky berie prvý. Pitku hráte obaja naraz; odpovede na NA EX idú lícom dole a otočia sa naraz. Vo finále útočí zaostávajúci — kto má menej špakov.
sk.p13:
Obranca vyberie lokalitu, o ktorú sa bude biť, a víťaz hádky z minulého kola ju

natočí

(v prvom kole a po remíze v hádke ten, kto vyberá). Lokalita leží v strede línie a delí ju na dva

kraje

. Natočenie určuje, ktorá hrana lokality patrí ktorému kraju — akcie hrany dostane, kto v tom kraji má prevahu. Efekt lokality platí len v kole, keď sa o ňu bije (tabuľka lokalít). Vo finále vyberá obranca — kto vedie — z troch pinnacle lokalít a hrá sa o ňu ako o každú inú.
sk.p14:
Karty ponuky ležia v dvoch balíčkoch lícom dole:

balíček nástrojov

a

balíček dedinčanov

(všetky ostatné karty). Nevzaté karty zo starej ponuky idú naspodok svojho balíčka. Potom si každý vezme 2 karty z balíčka nástrojov a 6 z balíčka dedinčanov. Obaja naraz a tajne dáte 4 do ponuky v ľubovoľnom mixe a zvyšné 4 naspodok ich balíčka (súper ich nevidí). Nič si nepodávate; ponuka má 8 kariet. Keď niektorý balíček nestačí, chýbajúce karty dá druhý.
sk.p15: Beriete striedavo, začína obranca — na svojom prvom ťahu len 1 kartu, aby nevykradol ponuku. Inak na ťahu vezmeš 1 kartu za 1 cigaretu alebo 2 karty za 3 cigarety. Za ponuku sa poldeci neplatí. Kto prestane, druhému ostáva už len jeden ťah; kto nemá cigaretu, prestane sám. Potom sa ponuka doplní na 8 kariet — najprv z balíčka nástrojov, kým v nej nie sú aspoň 2 Nástroje, zvyšok z balíčka dedinčanov. Väzni počet kariet stavby nemenia.
sk.p16: Zajíma a presviedča sa po bitke, keď sa rozdeľuje Nakladačka a hádka (kapitola Starší a Nakladačka). Vo finále ani jedno.
sk.p17:
Zajatie — kto rozdeľuje Nakladačku, zajme za 5 bodov staršieho, pri ktorom má svoj strach na červenej už pred touto Nakladačkou — teda od minulého kola; strach dotiahnutý na červenú v tom istom rozdelení nestačí. Na stole sa pri takom staršom ukáže pečiatka ZAJAŤ. Smie aj viac naraz a nemusí. Starší je jeho

väzeň

: leží medzi jeho priznanými kartami, zo stupnice zmizne a súper mu odovzdá toľko špakov, koľko bodov hádky má pri ňom v rečiach — koľko jeho stupne rečí stáli (žltá 1, oranžová 2, červená 3) —, najviac koľko má. Väzeň sa ráta ako červená a má schopnosť. Väzni na výhru podľa ligy — Tretia 2, Druhá 3, Prvá 4 — končia hru hneď.
sk.p18: Presvedčenie — kto rozdeľuje hádku, presvedčí za 3 body ktoréhokoľvek staršieho, keď má pri ňom reči na celom teplomere (dotiahnuť ich smie v tom istom rozdelení; na stole pečiatka PRESVEDČIŤ). Reči, strach oboch aj priazeň ostávajú. Karta staršieho ide do jeho ruky a natrvalo patrí do jeho balíčka — hrá sa ako Starešina, len akcie; schopnosť väzňa nemá. Kto prvý presvedčí, toho je; zajať presvedčeného smú obaja — karta potom zmizne odkiaľkoľvek do pivnice.

zhromazdenie.skratka.1: You lay a card on either end of the line; it stays yours.
zhromazdenie.skratka.2: An action only counts when, in a link, it meets a neighbour's action at the same height.
zhromazdenie.skratka.3: Play limit = full shots; every card turns one to empty.
zhromazdenie.skratka.4: Passing gives no cigarettes — the full shots you didn't play stay yours.
zhromazdenie.skratka.5: Clash and Support trigger when a card is placed; bonus actions from the seal and Retraining change the cards' actions.
zhromazdenie.h.zhromazdenie-linia: The line, two ends and two wings
zhromazdenie.p1:
The cards form one continuous

line

 with no branches. The location in the middle splits it into two

wings

. On your turn you lay a card on either of the two

ends of the line

 — neither is yours. The card always faces you and stays yours — its actions and effects count for you, wherever it lies. In the finale too a location lies in the middle — the pinnacle — and cards are laid against it as in every round.
zhromazdenie.p2:
Cards in the line touch at their edges. A card pairs with its inner edge — the one facing the location — with the neighbour closer to the middle (or with the location). An action is active when two non-empty actions meet at the same height in a

link

. An action with no partner does nothing, and each active action counts separately. When you drag a card onto the table, the game shows what it will link with before you let go.
zhromazdenie.p3:
In the Assembly you take turns playing; the attacker starts. Every card into the line costs you a full shot — it turns to empty, so you play as many cards as you have full shots (the

play limit

). Without a full shot you don't play. NA EX is poured in the Booze-up, but its shot leaves your stock for the card — you're one short in the round's next Assembly. Tucking a Tool, the Heirloom and confessing cost no shots. Your opponent's Wine Taster guzzles one of your full shots on the spot. After every Booze-up one empty shot gets refilled for free, and after the brawl they're all restored.
zhromazdenie.p4:
When you don't want to play, you

pass

: you play nothing more until the Booze-up and your opponent may carry on alone. You get nothing for passing — the full shots you didn't play stay yours for NA EX and the next Assembly. When you have no other option, the game passes for you.
zhromazdenie.p5:
The actions of the location's edge go to the player with the

upper hand

in that

wing

— whoever has more of their own Citizens, Animals and Elders there (a tucked Tool doesn't count). On a tie, the player whose card lies right next to the location in that wing. So a single opponent's card in a wing doesn't steal the edge's actions, but it does form a link with them: as the first card by the location it decides which of the edge's actions get activated, and those go to the player with the upper hand. Wings are named after the location, for example in the Pub “by the tap” and “by the door”.
zhromazdenie.p6:
Some effects trigger when cards meet through placing — you lay a card on the end of the line against another.

Clash

triggers when a card meets an opponent's (you place yours, or they place theirs against yours),

Support

when two of your own cards meet. With a tag after the colon (“Support: Old-timer”) only with a card of that tag; with no tag, with any card. Tucking a Tool, NA EX, a collision or moving a card don't trigger them.

Ally

with a tag applies while you have another face-up card with that tag in your crew,

Enemy

while your opponent has one in theirs.
zhromazdenie.p7:
Bonus actions

are in the seal at the bottom of the card's illustration. They're active actions of the card's owner, off the edges, and they count as the same actions. With Ally and Enemy they apply once, while the condition holds; with Always (no condition) once, while the card lies there; with Support and Clash once for each meeting, until the end of the round. Boost, Resistance, NA EX and a tucked Tool don't change them; Tools in the Heirloom (for example the Shepherd's Axe) do. The

Burn

flame in the seal (Crocodile) isn't an action: the card it meets (with the Crocodile, an opponent's Citizen) is burnt at the end of the brawl.
zhromazdenie.p8:
A

Trainer

(a Citizen or Animal) has the effect

Retraining

X → Y: another card's action X counts as Y — before links are made, on both edges and in bonus actions. With the Always trigger it retrains both neighbours (opponent's cards too) while they're next to it; with Support your card, and with Clash the opponent's card it meets, until the end of the round. Changes chain: first Trainers in the order they triggered, then tucked Tools in the order they were tucked — each changes what the one before produced. The Gym Bro (Punch → Wallop) plus a Shepherd's Axe under the card (Wallop → Haymaker) make a Haymaker.
zhromazdenie.p9:
You have a hand (no limit), a draw pile and a discard pile. When the draw pile runs out, the discard pile is shuffled and becomes the new draw pile. Down by you, you see your

shots

(full and empty),

cigarettes

,

liver

,

Debts

, the round's

vices

,

Thirst

and your

butts

.
zhromazdenie.p10: Actions on the edges — at most 4 on each edge, at heights 0 (top) to 3 (bottom). An action only counts when it meets a neighbour's action at the same height. A Tool has a top and a bottom edge instead (chapter Tools and the Heirloom).
zhromazdenie.p11:
Tags — the kind of card (

Citizen, Animal, Elder, Tool

…). They do nothing by themselves; effects refer to them.
zhromazdenie.p12:
Effect — the card's text. The bold word at the start says when (Arrival, Booze-up, Brawl, Always, Support, Ally…), the words in italics say what.

Bonus actions

are in the seal at the bottom of the illustration. The exact meanings are in the glossary.
zhromazdenie.p13: Variants — every card exists in several variants: the same actions at different heights. Browse the cards.

sk.skratka.1: Kartu kladieš na ktorýkoľvek koniec línie; ostáva tvoja.
sk.skratka.2: Akcia platí, len keď sa na spoji stretne s akciou suseda v rovnakej výške.
sk.skratka.3: Limit vykladania = plné poldeci; každá karta jeden otočí na vypitý.
sk.skratka.4: Pas cigarety nedá — nevyložené plné poldeci ti ostanú.
sk.skratka.5: Konflikt a Podpora sa spustia priložením karty; akcie navyše z pečate a Preškolenie menia akcie kariet.
sk.h.zhromazdenie-linia: Línia, dva konce a dva kraje
sk.p1:
Karty tvoria jednu súvislú

líniu

 bez vetvenia. Lokalita v strede ju delí na dva

kraje

. Na ťahu položíš kartu na ktorýkoľvek z dvoch

koncov línie

 — žiaden nie je tvoj. Karta je vždy natočená k tebe a ostáva tvoja — jej akcie aj efekty sa rátajú tebe, nech leží kdekoľvek. Aj vo finále leží v strede lokalita — pinnacle — a karty sa kladú k nej ako v každom kole.
sk.p2:
Karty v línii sa dotýkajú hranami. Karta sa páruje vnútornou hranou — tou, ktorá je obrátená k lokalite — so susedom bližšie k stredu (alebo s lokalitou). Akcia je aktívna, keď sa na

spoji

stretnú dve neprázdne akcie v rovnakej výške. Akcia bez partnera nerobí nič a každá aktívna akcia sa počíta samostatne. Keď kartu ťaháš na stôl, hra ešte pred pustením ukáže, s čím sa spojí.
sk.p3:
V Zhromaždení vykladáte striedavo, začína útočník. Každá karta do línie ťa stojí plný poldeci — otočí sa na vypitý, takže vyložíš toľko kariet, koľko máš plných poldeci (

limit vykladania

). Bez plného poldeci nevykladáš. NA EX sa dáva v Pitke, ale jeho poldeci odíde zo zásoby na kartu — v ďalšom Zhromaždení kola ti chýba. Podloženie Nástroja, Dedičstvo ani priznanie poldeci nestoja. Súperova Degustátorka ti plný poldeci vyžerie hneď. Po každej Pitke sa ti jeden vypitý poldeci doleje zadarmo a po bitke sa obnovia všetky.
sk.p4:
Keď nechceš vykladať,

pasuješ

: do Pitky už nevykladáš a súper môže pokračovať sám. Za pas nič nedostaneš — plné poldeci, ktoré si nevyložil, ti ostanú na NA EX a ďalšie Zhromaždenie. Keď nemáš inú možnosť, hra pasuje za teba.
sk.p5:
Akcie hrany lokality dostane hráč s

prevahou

v tom

kraji

— kto tam má viac svojich Občanov, Zvierat a Starešinov (podložený Nástroj sa neráta). Pri rovnosti hráč, ktorého karta v kraji leží hneď pri lokalite. Jedna súperova karta v kraji teda neukradne akcie hrany, ale tvorí s nimi spoj: ako prvá karta pri lokalite určuje, ktoré akcie hrany sa aktivujú, a tie dostane hráč s prevahou. Kraje majú mená podľa lokality, napríklad v Krčme „pri výčape“ a „pri dverách“.
sk.p6:
Niektoré efekty sa spustia, keď sa karty stretnú priložením — kartu položíš na koniec línie k inej.

Konflikt

sa spustí, keď sa karta stretne so súperovou (prikladáš ty, alebo súper k tvojej),

Podpora

, keď sa stretnú dve tvoje karty. S tagom za dvojbodkou („Podpora: Pamätník“) len pri karte s tým tagom, bez tagu pri ktorejkoľvek. Podloženie Nástroja, NA EX, zrážka ani presun karty ich nespustia.

Spoločník

s tagom platí, kým máš v partii inú odkrytú kartu s tým tagom,

Nepriateľ

, kým ju má v partii súper.
sk.p7:
Akcie navyše

sú v pečati dole v ilustrácii karty. Sú to aktívne akcie majiteľa karty mimo hrán a rátajú sa ako tie isté akcie. Pri Spoločníkovi a Nepriateľovi platia raz, kým platí podmienka; pri Furt (bez podmienky) raz, kým karta leží; pri Podpore a Konflikte za každé stretnutie, do konca kola. Posilnenie suseda, Odpor ani NA EX ich nemenia, Nástroje v Dedičstve (napríklad Valaška) áno. Mení ich aj karta sama: Školiteľ a podložený Nástroj ich preškolia ako akcie na hranách, hrana posilnenia Nástroja aj Forsáž karty (zo spoja či z Energeťáka) ich posilnia ×2 (Puška pod Šoférom: jeho Pecka navyše ×2). Plameň

Spálenie

v pečati (Krokodíl) nie je akcia: karta, s ktorou sa stretne (pri Krokodílovi súperov Občan), sa na konci bitky spáli.
sk.p8:
Školiteľ

(Občan alebo Zviera) má efekt

Preškolenie

X → Y: akcia X inej karty sa ráta ako Y — ešte pred spojmi, na oboch hranách aj v akciách navyše. Pri spúšťači Furt preškolí oboch susedov (aj súperove karty), kým s ním susedia; pri Podpore tvoju kartu a pri Konflikte súperovu, s ktorou sa stretne, do konca kola. Premeny sa reťazia: najprv Školitelia v poradí, ako sa spustili, potom podložené Nástroje v poradí podloženia — každá premení, čo urobila predošlá. Sypač Rana → Pecka a pod kartou Valaška Pecka → Petelica dajú Petelicu.
sk.p9:
Máš ruku (bez limitu), doberací balíček a odhadzovací balíček. Keď sa doberací balíček minie, odhadzovací sa zamieša a stane sa z neho nový doberací balíček. Dole pri sebe vidíš svoje

poldeci

(plné a vypité),

cigarety

,

pečeň

,

Dlhy

,

neresti

kola,

Chuť

a svoje

špaky

.
sk.p10: Akcie na hranách — najviac 4 na každej hrane, vo výškach 0 (hore) až 3 (dole). Akcia platí, len keď sa stretne s akciou suseda v rovnakej výške. Nástroj má namiesto nich hornú a dolnú hranu (kapitola Nástroje a Dedičstvo).
sk.p11:
Tagy — druh karty (

Občan, Zviera, Starešina, Nástroj

…). Samy nič nerobia, odkazujú na ne efekty.
sk.p12:
Efekt — text karty. Tučné slovo na začiatku hovorí kedy (Nástup, Pitka, Bitka, Furt, Podpora, Spoločník…), slová kurzívou čo.

Akcie navyše

sú v pečati dole v ilustrácii. Presné významy sú v slovníku.
sk.p13: Varianty — každá karta existuje vo viacerých variantoch: rovnaké akcie, iné výšky. Prezri si karty.

pitka.skratka.1: Number of booze-ups = 1 + the smaller count of activated location actions from its two wings.
pitka.skratka.2: You both play the Booze-up at the same time and each finishes on their own; NA EX are revealed at once and answers to them go face down.
pitka.skratka.3: You choose NA EX in secret; it's revealed when you've both finished.
pitka.skratka.4: NA EX cancels a card's active actions and doubles its inactive ones; the card must have both.
pitka.skratka.5: You answer each of your opponent's NA EX with one card face down — the attacker first, then the defender on the other wing of the line; they flip over at once.
pitka.skratka.6: Smoking only happens in the Booze-up.
pitka.p1:
After the Assembly comes the

Booze-up

. In a brawl there are 1 + the smaller of the counts of activated location actions in its two wings (1 to 5). A location action is activated by a card that forms a link with it; a Resistance on the location's edge counts, an edge action cancelled by a card's Resistance doesn't. If 3 location actions are activated in one wing and 1 in the other, 2 booze-ups are drunk — it's counted by wings, not by who played the card; a ×2 action is still one. Before every Booze-up there's an Assembly. The number changes with the line during the round — a Booze-up once started is always drunk to the end. A location's level is the number of actions on its edge (1, 2, 3, pinnacle 4), so a round has 1 to 5 booze-ups. The number of booze-ups doesn't set the butts — the winner of the brawl gets a butt for every card in the line.
pitka.p2: You both play the Booze-up at the same time. Until you finish it, you may smoke, refill, barter and secretly choose a NA EX — you see your opponent's purchases straight away, their NA EX you don't. Once you've finished, there's no going back. When you've both finished, the NA EX are revealed at once and you answer them face down — the attacker first, then the defender on the other wing of the line; both flip over at once. The only exception is the Earwig: its owner waits until the opponent has finished, then plays and sees their NA EX. Then the Booze-up is reckoned:
pitka.p4: Gamble — one Debt for each action (a counter, confessed at once).
pitka.p5: Liver Damage — a Cirrhosis for every full threshold.
pitka.p7: Cigarettes — for Cigarette actions (minus the opponent's Restrictions).
pitka.p8:
Vision

— for each active Vision you look at the top card of your deck and either take it into your hand or burn it for good.
pitka.p9: Last Orders cards flip face up (chapter Advanced moves).
pitka.p10: The Booze-up itself gives no cards — you draw them by smoking and with Vision. A free card from the Market comes from the Bus Stop after the first Booze-up and from the Support of the Shop Assistant (a Citizen) or the Tradesman (a Tool).
pitka.p11:
In the Booze-up, until you finish it, you put a full shot on a card in the line tagged Citizen or Elder — yours or your opponent's. Normally once per Booze-up. The card must have at least one active and at least one inactive action; otherwise

NA EX

would change nothing. You choose NA EX in secret — your opponent doesn't know whether you poured one or where, until you've both finished.
pitka.p12: NA EX cancels a card's active actions and doubles its inactive ones. The actions count for the card's owner: on your own card you double a Haymaker or cancel your own Gamble; on your opponent's you cancel what they needed, but double their inactive ones for them. Multipliers multiply — a NA EX next to the Strong, Independent Woman gives ×4, Gamble and Liver Damage included. The shot lies on the card until the brawl, so the NA EX is reckoned in every Booze-up of the round; the liver +1 is yours (added at the reveal) and the shot gets drunk in the brawl. Before you confirm, the game shows you the brawl before and after, and the curses it will bring.
pitka.p13: It can't go on a card that already has a shot on it, nor on a card with Plonk, an Injection or a Pitchfork tucked under it.
pitka.p14: Nor can it go on a card with an active Resistance — a Resistance is active only without a link, and it shields the card. The Resistance doesn't count towards the condition at all; an inactive Pact and an inactive Boost do (NA EX doesn't double them).
pitka.p15: An action cancelled by Resistance is neither active nor inactive — a NA EX on its card won't double it.
pitka.p16: At the Church, only on a card at the end of the line (either of the two ends), furthest from the Church.
pitka.p17: A NA EX on the card next to the location changes only the card's actions — the actions of the location's edge stay active.
pitka.p18: A NA EX on a card with a Boost cancels the Boost and the ×2 it was giving its partner in the link — the partner's action (the location's edge too) stays active, but only ×1. The same goes for every cancelled action: its partner in the link stays active ×1.
pitka.p19: A Resistance in a link is left alone by NA EX — the action the Resistance cancels stays cancelled; NA EX turns the card's other actions over as usual.
pitka.p20: The shot as a partner: an unpaired Resistance or Boost on a card with a NA EX pairs with the shot. A Resistance snuffs out the NA EX — the card is as if without it, and the shot gets drunk anyway (this happens with the opponent's Last Orders or a NA EX from Plonk, until the Resistance gets paired). A Boost holds up the NA EX — it doesn't cancel the card's active actions, and doubles the inactive ones. When a card has both, the Resistance wins.
pitka.p21: The Veteran is the exception: NA EX doubles his active actions (doesn't cancel them) and leaves the inactive ones alone.
pitka.p22: Your opponent's Last Orders card (face down) may always take a NA EX.
pitka.p23: At the Pub everyone who has a full shot and somewhere to put it must pour a NA EX; at the Wine Cellar you may pour twice per Booze-up.
pitka.p24: When you've both finished, the NA EX are revealed at once — both shots land on the cards at the same time. Only then is the liver added (at the Wake, your opponent gets it). Then the answers.
pitka.p25:
Collision: if you both chose the same card, it becomes a

Hooligan

. It first pairs with its neighbours as usual, then all its actions turn into Punches for its owner — even the ones with no partner. Its Boost and Resistance become nothing but Punches too — they neither double nor cancel the neighbour. A Hooligan's Punches always count ×1; not even the Strong, Independent Woman doubles them. Each player pays for their own NA EX (liver, shot). After the brawl the Hooligan sobers up and the card has its original actions again.
pitka.p26:
After the reveal, for each of your opponent's NA EX you may lay one card from your hand on either end of the line — face down, for a full shot: you down it as you answer (liver +1 at once; it counts as a vice); without a full shot you don't answer. An

answer

is outside normal card play. The attacker answers first, then the defender — only on the other wing of the line (if the attacker didn't answer, on either). You don't see your opponent's answer until both flip over at once; only then are their Arrival and Booze-up effects reckoned. Ideally you pair up the inactive actions of the NA EX card: they become active and the NA EX cancels them. An answer may change the upper hand in a wing and the number of booze-ups.
pitka.h.pitka-cigarety: Smoking, barter and the refill after the Booze-up
pitka.p27:
Smoking

— a card from your deck at once; only in the Booze-up, until you finish it, not in the Assembly. The first smoke in a Booze-up costs 1 cigarette, the second 2, the third 3… and every Booze-up starts again from 1. At the Petrol Station every smoke is 1 cigarette cheaper: the first free, the second 1, the third 2…
pitka.p28:
Refill

— at the end of every Booze-up one of your empty shots turns back to full for free, plus one more for each of your active Shot actions in the line. There's no refilling for cigarettes.
pitka.p29:
Gutter barter

— in the Booze-up, a new full shot for 5 cigarettes; it's yours for good and gets restored with the others after the brawl.
pitka.p30: After every brawl all shots are restored to full — not after the finale. Whatever you have left after the finale gets cashed in: a full shot 1 butt, every 5 cigarettes 1 butt.
pitka.p31:
Whoever has a

prisoner

may use their ability once per game, whenever they like — on their turn while taking from the Market, in the Assembly or in the Booze-up (in the finale too). It costs nothing. Then it's spent and the prisoner stays in the cellar (and still counts as terrified). An elder's card in your hand or in the line has no ability. The game won't offer an ability that would do nothing.
pitka.p34: Priest — Remove one of your opponent's NA EX from a card. Their shot stays empty.
pitka.p35: Mayor — Until the end of the round all active location actions are boosted (for both players, Booze-up actions too).
pitka.p36: Vet — Discard all confessed Cirrhoses and Cirrhoses in your hand.
pitka.p37: Matron — Your opponent passes in this Assembly at once.
pitka.p38: Bus Driver — Take as many cards from the Market as you like, 1 cigarette each; when you stop, your opponent may carry on.
pitka.p39: Gravedigger — Take 1 card from your opponent's discard pile into your hand.

sk.skratka.1: Počet Pitiek = 1 + menší počet aktivovaných akcií lokality z jej dvoch krajov.
sk.skratka.2: Pitku hráte obaja naraz, každý skončí sám; NA EX sa odkryjú naraz a odpovede na ne idú lícom dole.
sk.skratka.3: NA EX vyberáte skryto; odkryje sa, keď ste hotoví obaja.
sk.skratka.4: NA EX zruší aktívne a zdvojí neaktívne akcie karty; karta musí mať oboje.
sk.skratka.5: Na každé súperovo NA EX odpovieš jednou kartou lícom dole — najprv útočník, potom obranca na druhý kraj línie; otočia sa naraz.
sk.p1:
Po Zhromaždení nasleduje

Pitka

. V bitke je ich 1 + menší z počtov aktivovaných akcií lokality v jej dvoch krajoch (1 až 5). Akciu lokality aktivuje karta, ktorá s ňou tvorí spoj; Odpor na hrane lokality sa ráta, akcia hrany zrušená Odporom karty nie. Ak sú v jednom kraji aktivované 3 akcie lokality a v druhom 1, pijú sa 2 Pitky — ráta sa podľa krajov, nie podľa toho, kto kartu zahral; akcia ×2 je stále jedna. Pred každou Pitkou je Zhromaždenie. Počet sa počas kola mení s líniou — začatá Pitka sa vždy dopije. Úroveň lokality je počet akcií na jej hrane (1, 2, 3, pinnacle 4), takže kolo má 1 až 5 Pitiek. Počet Pitiek špaky neurčuje — víťaz bitky dostane špak za každú kartu v línii.
sk.p2: Pitku hráte obaja naraz. Kým ju neskončíš, smieš fajčiť, doliať, barterovať a skryto vybrať NA EX — súperove nákupy vidíš hneď, jeho NA EX nie. Keď skončíš, nedá sa to vrátiť. Keď ste hotoví obaja, NA EX sa odkryjú naraz a odpovedáte na ne lícom dole — najprv útočník, potom obranca na druhý kraj línie; obe sa otočia naraz. Jediná výnimka je Bzdocha: jej majiteľ čaká, kým súper skončí, a potom hrá a vidí jeho NA EX. Potom sa Pitka vyhodnotí:
sk.p4: Hazard — za každú akciu jeden Dlh (počítadlo, hneď priznaný).
sk.p5: Poškodenie pečene — za každý celý prah Cirhóza.
sk.p7: Cigarety — za akcie Cigareta (mínus súperove Obmedzenia).
sk.p8:
Vízia

— za každú aktívnu Víziu pozrieš vrchnú kartu svojho balíčka a vezmeš si ju do ruky, alebo ju navždy spáliš.
sk.p9: Záverečné karty sa otočia lícom hore (kapitola Pokročilé ťahy).
sk.p10: Pitka sama karty nedáva — doberáš si ich fajčením a Víziou. Kartu z ponuky zadarmo ti dá Zastávka po prvej Pitke a Podpora Živnostníka (Nástroj); Predavačka ti ju dá navrch doberacieho balíčka.
sk.p11:
V Pitke, kým ju neskončíš, položíš plný poldeci na kartu v línii s tagom Občan alebo Starešina — svoju aj súperovu. V základe raz za Pitku. Karta musí mať aspoň jednu aktívnu a aspoň jednu neaktívnu akciu; inak by

NA EX

nič nezmenilo. NA EX vyberáš skryto — súper nevie, či si ho dal ani kam, kým nie ste hotoví obaja.
sk.p12: NA EX karte zruší aktívne akcie a zdvojí neaktívne. Akcie sa rátajú majiteľovi karty: na svojej si zdvojíš Petelicu alebo zrušíš vlastný Hazard, na súperovej mu zrušíš, čo potreboval, ale jeho neaktívne mu zdvojíš. Násobky sa násobia — NA EX vedľa Silnej ženy dá ×4, aj Hazardu a Poškodeniu pečene. Poldeci leží na karte do bitky, takže NA EX sa vyhodnotí v každej Pitke kola; pečeň +1 je tvoja (pripíše sa pri odkrytí) a v bitke sa poldeci vypije. Pred potvrdením ti hra ukáže bitku pred a po aj kliatby, ktoré z toho budú.
sk.p13: Nedá sa dať na kartu, na ktorej už poldeci leží, ani na kartu, pod ktorou leží Vínko, Injekcia alebo Vidly.
sk.p14: Nedá sa dať ani na kartu s aktívnym Odporom — Odpor je aktívny len bez spoja a kartu chráni. Do podmienky sa Odpor neráta vôbec; neaktívny Pakt aj neaktívne Posilnenie áno (NA EX ich nezdvojí).
sk.p15: Akcia zrušená Odporom nie je ani aktívna, ani neaktívna — NA EX na jej karte ju nezdvojí.
sk.p16: Na Kostole len na kartu na konci línie (na ktoromkoľvek z dvoch koncov), najďalej od Kostola.
sk.p17: NA EX na kartu pri lokalite mení len akcie karty — akcie hrany lokality ostávajú aktívne.
sk.p18: NA EX na kartu s Posilnením zruší Posilnenie aj ×2, ktoré dávalo partnerovi na spoji — partnerova akcia (aj hrana lokality) ostáva aktívna, ale len ×1. Rovnako pri každej zrušenej akcii: jej partner na spoji ostáva aktívny ×1.
sk.p19: Odpor na spoji NA EX nechá tak — akcia, ktorú Odpor ruší, ostáva zrušená; ostatné akcie karty NA EX obráti ako zvyčajne.
sk.p20: Poldeci ako partner: nespárovaný Odpor alebo Posilnenie karty s NA EX sa spáruje s poldecom. Odpor NA EX zahasí — karta je ako bez neho, poldeci sa aj tak vypije (stane sa to pri súperovej Záverečnej či NA EX z Vínka, kým sa Odpor nespáruje). Posilnenie NA EX podrží — aktívne akcie karty nezruší, neaktívne zdvojí. Keď má karta oboje, vyhrá Odpor.
sk.p21: Veterán je výnimka: NA EX mu aktívne akcie zdvojí (nezruší) a neaktívne nechá.
sk.p22: Súperovu Záverečnú (lícom dole) smie dostať NA EX vždy.
sk.p23: V Krčme musí dať NA EX každý, kto má plný poldeci a kam ho dať; vo Vínnej pivnici smieš dvakrát za Pitku.
sk.p24: Keď ste hotoví obaja, NA EX sa odkryjú naraz — oba poldeci ľahnú na karty súčasne. Až vtedy sa pripíše pečeň (na Kare ju dostane súper). Potom odpovede.
sk.p25:
Zrážka: ak ste obaja vybrali tú istú kartu, je z nej

Výtržník

. So susedmi sa najprv spáruje ako obvykle, potom sa všetky jej akcie zmenia na Rany pre jej majiteľa — aj tie bez partnera. Aj jej Posilnenie a Odpor sú už len Rany — suseda nezdvojujú ani nerušia. Rany Výtržníka platia vždy ×1, nezdvojí ich ani Silná nezávislá žena. Každý platí za svoje NA EX (pečeň, poldeci). Po bitke Výtržník vytriezvie a karta má znova pôvodné akcie.
sk.p26:
Po odkrytí smieš za každé súperovo NA EX vyložiť jednu kartu z ruky na ktorýkoľvek koniec línie — lícom dole, za plný poldeci: pri odpovedi ho vypiješ (pečeň +1 hneď, ráta sa ako nerest), bez plného poldeci neodpovedáš.

Odpoveď

je mimo vykladania. Najprv odpovedá útočník, potom obranca — len na druhý kraj línie (keď útočník neodpovedal, na ktorýkoľvek). Súperovu odpoveď nevidíš, kým sa obe neotočia naraz; až potom sa vyhodnotí ich Nástup a Pitka. Najlepšie tak, aby si spároval neaktívne akcie karty s NA EX: tie sa stanú aktívnymi a NA EX ich zruší. Odpoveď smie zmeniť prevahu v kraji aj počet Pitiek.
sk.h.pitka-cigarety: Fajčenie, barter a doliatie po Pitke
sk.p27:
Fajčenie

— karta z balíčka hneď; len v Pitke, kým ju neskončíš, v Zhromaždení nie. Prvé fajčenie v Pitke stojí 1 cigaretu, druhé 2, tretie 3… a každá Pitka začína znova od 1. Na Benzínke je každé fajčenie o 1 cigaretu lacnejšie: prvé zadarmo, druhé 1, tretie 2…
sk.p28:
Doliatie

— na konci každej Pitky sa ti jeden vypitý poldeci otočí na plný zadarmo a ďalší za každú tvoju aktívnu akciu Poldeci v línii. Za cigarety sa nedolieva.
sk.p29:
Stokársky barter

— v Pitke za 5 cigariet nový plný poldeci; máš ho natrvalo a po bitke sa obnoví s ostatnými.
sk.p30: Po každej bitke sa všetky poldeci obnovia na plné — po finále nie. Čo ti po finále ostane, sa vykúpi: plný poldeci 1 špak, každých 5 cigariet 1 špak.
sk.p31:
Kto má

väzňa

, smie jeho schopnosť použiť raz za hru, kedy chce — vo svojom ťahu pri braní z ponuky, v Zhromaždení alebo v Pitke (aj vo finále). Nič nestojí. Potom je minutá a väzeň ostáva v pivnici (ráta sa ďalej ako vydesený). Karta staršieho v ruke či v línii schopnosť nemá. Schopnosť, ktorá by nič neurobila, hra neponúkne.
sk.p34: Farár — Odstráň jedno súperovo NA EX z karty. Jeho poldeci ostáva vypitý.
sk.p35: Starosta — Do konca kola sú všetky aktívne akcie lokality posilnené (obom, aj akcie Pitky).
sk.p36: Veterinár — Odhoď všetky priznané Cirhózy a Cirhózy na ruke.
sk.p37: Vychovávateľka — Súper v tomto Zhromaždení hneď pasuje.
sk.p38: Autobusár — Z ponuky berieš kariet, koľko chceš, každú za jednu cigaretu; keď skončíš, môže pokračovať súper.
sk.p39: Hrobár — Vezmi si do ruky 1 kartu zo súperovho odhadzovacieho balíčka.

cena-pitia.skratka.1: The liver is counted only in the Booze-up and then resets to zero.
cena-pitia.skratka.2: A Cirrhosis for every full liver threshold, a Debt for every Gamble action.
cena-pitia.skratka.3: Fewer vices in a round than your Thirst = a Shakes card into your deck.
cena-pitia.p1:
Every Liver Damage action, every Shot action and every NA EX adds to your

liver

. It's reckoned only in the Booze-up: for every full threshold (3; Alcohol-free in the Heirloom and the Pub raise it) you get a

Cirrhosis

card — it goes to your discard pile. After the Booze-up the liver resets to zero; the remainder under the threshold doesn't carry over. Every extra card in an Assembly turn (Down one) adds +1 liver to the next Booze-up. The Loving Wife in the line lowers your liver in the Booze-up by 1.
cena-pitia.p2:
Every Gamble action gives you one

Debt

in the Booze-up — it's not a card but a counter: it's confessed at once, you don't draw it, and you don't draw a card for it. 1

indebtedness

from a card effect is likewise a Debt. Debts given directly by a card (for example the Eligible Lass) go straight on. So more booze-ups in a brawl mean more liver and more Debts. The board shows you in advance what the cards on the table will add and how many curses that will make.
cena-pitia.p3: Only with the Fruit Machine in your Heirloom do you get a Debt for every 2 indebtedness. The remainder isn't wiped after the Booze-up — the landlord chalks up the tally and it stays on your account into the next Booze-up and round.
cena-pitia.p4:
A

vice

is only what you drink and smoke: every extra card in a turn (Down one) 1, an answer to NA EX 1, every NA EX 2 (it's a bigger dose) and every cigarette smoked 1 (so the second smoke in a Booze-up, for 2 cigarettes, is 2; at the Petrol Station, for 1 cigarette, 1; a free smoke nothing). The shot for the first card of a turn, the refill after the Booze-up, barter, the Market, Last Orders and the Heirloom aren't vices.
cena-pitia.p5:
Thirst

is your public number, 0 at the start — once you get used to it, you have to keep going. At the end of the round:
cena-pitia.p6:
Fewer vices than your Thirst → you get a

Shakes

card in your discard pile.
cena-pitia.p7: Then Thirst = the greater of (Thirst, the round's vices) − 1. A bender raises it; every round after that it drops by 1.
cena-pitia.p8: Your opponent doesn't set your bar. The Shakes can't be confessed or played; after the brawl it goes back from your hand to the discard pile and you draw it again. Every Shakes card in your deck (hand, draw pile, discard pile) takes 1 hard off you in the brawl — your hands are shaking — and on a tie on hard whoever has more of them loses. Only Vision may burn it. After the finale nothing is settled, and at the end of the game the Shakes cost nothing. The game remembers how many Shakes you picked up over the game (a statistic).

sk.skratka.1: Pečeň sa počíta len v Pitke a potom sa vynuluje.
sk.skratka.2: Za každý celý prah pečene Cirhóza, za každú akciu Hazard Dlh.
sk.skratka.3: Menej nerestí v kole, než je tvoja Chuť = karta Absťák do balíčka.
sk.p1:
K

pečeni

prispieva každá akcia Poškodenie pečene, každá akcia Poldeci a každé NA EX. Vyhodnotí sa len v Pitke: za každý celý prah (3; Nealko v Dedičstve a Krčma ho zvyšujú) dostaneš kartu

Cirhóza

— ide do tvojho odhadzovacieho balíčka. Po Pitke sa pečeň vynuluje, zvyšok pod prahom sa neprenáša. Každá karta navyše v ťahu Zhromaždenia (Vypiť) pripíše +1 pečene do najbližšej Pitky. Milujúca manželka v línii ti zníži pečeň v Pitke o 1.
sk.p2:
Každá akcia Hazard ti v Pitke dá jeden

Dlh

— nie je to karta, ale počítadlo: je hneď priznaný, neťaháš ho a kartu zaň nedoberáš. Rovnako je Dlh aj 1

zadĺženie

z efektu karty. Dlhy, ktoré dáva priamo karta (napríklad Dievčina na vydaj), idú rovno. Viac Pitiek v bitke teda znamená viac pečene aj Dlhov. Doska ti vopred ukazuje, čo karty na stole pripíšu a koľko kliatob z toho bude.
sk.p3: Len s Výherným automatom v Dedičstve dostaneš Dlh až za každé 2 zadĺženia. Zvyšok sa po Pitke nemaže — krčmár píše čiarky a ostávajú ti na účte do ďalšej Pitky aj kola. Automat ti však v každej Pitke dá 1 Dlh sám.
sk.p4:
Nerest

je len to, čo vypiješ a vyfajčíš: každá karta navyše v ťahu (Vypiť) 1, odpoveď na NA EX 1, každé NA EX 2 (je to väčšia dávka) a každá vyfajčená cigareta 1 (druhé fajčenie v Pitke za 2 cigarety teda 2, na Benzínke za 1 cigaretu 1; fajčenie zadarmo nič). Poldeci za prvú kartu ťahu, doliatie po Pitke, barter, ponuka, Záverečná ani Dedičstvo nerest nie sú.
sk.p5:
Chuť

je tvoje verejné číslo, na začiatku 0 — kto si zvykne, musí pokračovať. Na konci kola:
sk.p6:
Menej nerestí, než je tvoja Chuť → dostaneš kartu

Absťák

do odhadzovacieho balíčka.
sk.p7: Potom Chuť = väčšie z (Chuť, neresti kola) − 1. Flám ju zdvihne, každé ďalšie kolo klesne o 1.
sk.p8: Súper ti latku neurčuje. Absťák sa nedá priznať ani vyložiť; po bitke sa z ruky vráti do odhadzovacieho balíčka a ťaháš ho znova. Každý Absťák v tvojom balíčku (ruka, doberací, odhadzovací) ti v bitke uberie 1 tuhé — trasú sa ti ruky — a pri remíze v tuhom prehráva, kto ich má viac. Spáliť ho smie len Vízia. Po finále sa nerieši nič a na konci hry Absťák nestojí nič. Hra si pamätá, koľko Absťákov si získal za hru (štatistika).

bitka.skratka.1: Hard: Punch 1, Wallop 2, Haymaker 3. Faith lowers it.
bitka.skratka.2: Argument: Scandal gives 2 soft, Superstition 1 (Faith cancels it). Whoever has more soft has won the argument and splits it onto their rumours after the brawl.
bitka.skratka.3: More hard wins: the winner gets 1 butt for every card in the line; the location goes on the noticeboard.
bitka.skratka.4: A tie is decided by fewer Shakes, then by fewer Debts; otherwise, the Tab.
bitka.skratka.5: The Thrashing is the difference in hard: the winner splits it onto their fear.
bitka.skratka.6: After the brawl the loser gets 1 cigarette and your opponent pays you protection money for your red fear; not after the finale.
bitka.p1:
Hard

damage (Punch 1, Wallop 2, Haymaker 3) decides who wins the brawl. Each of your confessed Cirrhoses gives your opponent +1 hard.

Scandal

and

Superstition

are

soft

damage — they do no hard; they're what the

argument

is fought with.
bitka.p2:
Faith

and Superstitions cancel out 1 : 1, piece for piece — one of your Faiths cancels one of your opponent's Superstitions, even one boosted by the Horoscope, and vice versa. The same goes for Faith from the Believer and Superstitions from the Gossip. Faith doesn't help against Scandal.
bitka.p3: Soft = Scandal × 2 + remaining Superstitions × 1 (× 2 with the Horoscope). Whoever has more has won the argument by the difference; on a tie, nobody.
bitka.p4:
After the brawl the winner of the argument splits it onto their

rumours

on the opponent's thermometers — among the elders as they like; a notch costs 1 into yellow, 2 into orange, 3 into red, and they're taken from the top of the opponent's fear downwards, then above it. Whatever isn't enough for any notch is forfeited. Favours don't change through the argument. In the finale it isn't split — the winner of the argument gets 1 butt for every point.
bitka.p5: Leftover Faith lowers your opponent's hard damage, never below 0. The Believer (favour) gives you an extra Faith — it cancels Superstitions and softens hard. Only the Holy Writ changes how much one Faith softens hard.
bitka.p6: Every Shakes card lowers your hard by 1 — the Teetotaller lets you off as many of them in the brawl as their strength.
bitka.p7:
Higher hard wins. On equal hard, whoever has fewer Shakes wins, and if you have the same number of those too, whoever has fewer confessed Debts. If even Debts don't decide it, nobody wins the brawl: the round's butts wait

on the Tab

, and the winner of the next brawl takes them on top; in the finale they're forfeited. On the Tab the attacker stays attacker, the elders score for both players only for rumours, and nobody gets a cigarette for losing.
bitka.p8:
The winner gets 1

butt

for every card lying in the line at the brawl — in the whole line, a revealed Last Orders included, in the finale too; confessed cards, the Heirloom and cards that left the line during the round don't count. The Shakes don't knock butts off. The winner doesn't take the location — it goes on the pub

noticeboard

with their name and butts. The Thrashing is the difference in hard damage — the winner holds it and splits it onto their fear; on a tie on hard there's no Thrashing, even if the Shakes or Debts decide the brawl.
bitka.h.bitka-kroky: Steps of the brawl in order
bitka.p9: Argument — Faith cancels Superstitions; whoever has more soft (Scandal 2, Superstition 1) has won the argument by the difference. Favours don't change; it gets split only later. A tie (not 0 : 0) is won by 0 by whoever has the Phone in their Heirloom. The Newspaper in the winner's Heirloom: the loser of the argument discards a random card from their hand.
bitka.p10: Damage — bonus actions from Brawl effects (Driver, Drunk…) are added to the hard from the line; hard is lowered by leftover Faith and by every Shakes card in your deck (the Teetotaller lets them off).
bitka.p11: Result — the winner (on a tie the Shakes decide, then Debts); otherwise the Tab.
bitka.p12: Butts for the brawl — the winner gets a butt for every card in the line (at the House of Culture each player only for their own, the winner too); whoever won the argument and lost the brawl gets a butt for each of their own cards; in the finale also a butt for every point of the Thrashing, and the winner of the argument for every point of the argument; the location goes on the noticeboard.
bitka.p13: The elders score by how things stood before raising — notches are worth 1 / 2 / 3 and go to whoever holds them: both players for their rumours, the winner also for their fear minus the notches the opponent has taken. Whoever lost the argument has their rumours drop a notch from the bottom.
bitka.p14: Victory by fear — a winner with red fear at at least 4 elders (prisoners count) wins on the spot.
bitka.p15: Bailiff — Work first, then the bailiff's visit to everyone with a confessed Debt: half the Debts burn, rounded up, and as many butts; the Allotment Man in your crew dodges it (chapter Curses and confession).
bitka.p16: The Thrashing and the argument — the winner of the brawl splits the Thrashing onto their fear and may capture, then the winner of the argument splits the argument onto their rumours and may persuade. Prisoners needed to win, by division, end the game at once. In the finale nothing is split — the points have already been butts.
bitka.p17: Shots — the shots from NA EX get drunk, and then all shots are restored to full (not after the finale).
bitka.p18:
Cigarettes after the brawl — the loser gets 1 cigarette (on the Tab and after the finale nobody does), the Godfather (whoever has his favour passes 2 / 3 / 4 confessed Debts on to the opponent), the Smoker (cigarettes after the brawl) and

protection money

(not after the finale); then the cards the Crocodile met are burnt.
bitka.p19: Cards go back to the discard pile of the player who played them; a tucked Tool to whoever tucked it.
bitka.p20: Graveyard — the loser of the brawl over the Graveyard may take 1 card from their own discard pile into their hand, including from the line just played.
bitka.p21: Curses from your hand — an unconfessed Cirrhosis and the Shakes go to the discard pile.
bitka.p22: Thirst and the Shakes — fewer vices than your Thirst = a Shakes card; then Thirst drops by 1 from the greater of Thirst and vices (not after the finale).
bitka.p23: New round — each player draws 2 cards, however many they're holding; their shots are already full from the brawl. There's no hand limit and nothing gets discarded.

sk.skratka.1: Tuhé: Rana 1, Pecka 2, Petelica 3. Viera ho znižuje.
sk.skratka.2: Hádka: Pohoršenie dá 2 mäkké, Povera 1 (Viera ju zruší). Kto má viac mäkkého, vyhral hádku a po bitke ju rozdelí na svoje reči.
sk.skratka.3: Viac tuhého vyhráva: víťaz dostane 1 špak za každú kartu v línii, lokalita ide na nástenku.
sk.skratka.4: Remízu rozhodne menej Absťákov, potom menej Dlhov, inak sekera.
sk.skratka.5: Nakladačka je rozdiel tuhého: víťaz ju rozdelí na svoj strach.
sk.skratka.6: Po bitke dostane porazený 1 cigaretu a súper ti zaplatí výpalné za tvoj červený strach; po finále nie.
sk.p1:
Tuhé

poškodenie (Rana 1, Pecka 2, Petelica 3) rozhoduje o víťazovi bitky. Každá tvoja priznaná Cirhóza dá súperovi +1 tuhé.

Pohoršenie

a

Povera

sú

mäkké

poškodenie — tuhé nerobia, hrá sa o ne

hádka

.
sk.p2:
Viera

a Povery sa vyrušia 1 : 1 na kusy — jedna tvoja Viera zruší jednu súperovu Poveru, aj vylepšenú Horoskopom, a naopak. Rovnako to platí aj pre Vieru z Veriaceho a Povery z Ohováračky. Proti Pohoršeniu Viera nepomáha.
sk.p3: Mäkké = Pohoršenie × 2 + zvyšné Povery × 1 (s Horoskopom × 2). Kto ho má viac, vyhral hádku o rozdiel; pri rovnosti nikto.
sk.p4:
Víťaz hádky ju po bitke rozdelí na svoje

reči

na teplomeroch súpera — ľubovoľne medzi starších; stupeň stojí do žltej 1, do oranžovej 2, do červenej 3 a obsadzuje sa od vrchu súperovho strachu nadol, potom nad neho. Čo nestačí na žiadny stupeň, prepadne. Priazne sa hádkou nemenia. Vo finále sa nerozdeľuje — víťaz hádky dostane 1 špak za každý bod.
sk.p5: Zvyšná Viera zníži súperovo tuhé poškodenie, pod 0 neklesne. Veriaci (priazeň) ti pridá Vieru navyše — ruší Povery aj tlmí tuhé. Hodnotu jednej Viery v tlmení tuhého mení len Svätý text.
sk.p6: Každý Absťák ti zníži tuhé o 1 — Abstinent ti ich v bitke toľko odpustí, aká je jeho sila.
sk.p7:
Vyhráva vyššie tuhé. Pri rovnakom tuhom vyhrá, kto má menej Absťákov, a keď aj tých máte rovnako, kto má menej priznaných Dlhov. Ak nerozhodnú ani Dlhy, bitku nevyhrá nikto: špaky kola čakajú

na sekere

a vezme si ich navyše víťaz najbližšej bitky; vo finále prepadnú. Útočník pri sekere ostáva útočníkom, starší bodujú obom len za reči a cigaretu za prehru nedostane nikto.
sk.p8:
Víťaz dostane 1

špak

za každú kartu, ktorá pri bitke leží v línii — v celej línii, aj odkrytá Záverečná, aj vo finále; priznané karty, Dedičstvo a karty, ktoré z línie počas kola zmizli, sa nerátajú. Absťáky špaky nezrážajú. Lokalitu si neberie — ide na krčmovú

nástenku

s jeho menom a špakmi. Nakladačka je rozdiel tuhého poškodenia — drží ju víťaz a rozdelí ju na svoj strach; pri remíze v tuhom Nakladačka nie je, aj keď bitku rozhodnú Absťáky či Dlhy.
sk.p9: Hádka — Viera ruší Povery, kto má viac mäkkého (Pohoršenie 2, Povera 1), vyhral hádku o rozdiel. Priazne sa nemenia, rozdelí sa až neskôr. Remízu (nie 0 : 0) vyhrá o 0, kto má v Dedičstve Telefón. Noviny v Dedičstve víťaza: porazený v hádke odhodí náhodnú kartu z ruky.
sk.p10: Poškodenie — k tuhému z línie sa pripočítajú akcie navyše z efektov Bitka (Šofér, Pijan…); tuhé znižuje zvyšná Viera a každý Absťák v tvojom balíčku (Abstinent ich odpustí).
sk.p11: Výsledok — víťaz (pri remíze rozhodnú Absťáky, potom Dlhy), inak sekera.
sk.p12: Špaky za bitku — víťaz dostane špak za každú kartu v línii (na Kultúrnom dome každý hráč len za svoje, aj víťaz); kto vyhral hádku a prehral bitku, dostane špak za každú svoju kartu; vo finále aj špak za každý bod Nakladačky a víťaz hádky za každý bod hádky; lokalita ide na nástenku.
sk.p13: Starší bodujú podľa stavu pred zdvihnutím — stupne majú hodnotu 1 / 2 / 3 a dostane ich ten, kto ich drží: obaja za svoje reči, víťaz navyše za svoj strach bez stupňov, ktoré obsadil súper. Kto prehral hádku, tomu reči klesnú zospodu o stupeň.
sk.p14: Výhra strachom — víťaz s červeným strachom aspoň u 4 starších (väzni sa rátajú) vyhráva hneď.
sk.p15: Exekútor — najprv Robota, potom exekúcia každému s priznaným Dlhom: zhorí polovica Dlhov nahor a rovnako veľa špakov; Záhradkár v partii ju obíde (kapitola Kliatby a priznanie).
sk.p16: Nakladačka a hádka — víťaz bitky rozdelí Nakladačku na svoj strach a smie zajímať, potom víťaz hádky rozdelí hádku na svoje reči a smie presviedčať. Väzni na výhru podľa ligy končia hru hneď. Vo finále sa nerozdeľuje — body už boli špaky.
sk.p17: Poldeci — poldeci z NA EX sa vypijú a potom sa všetky poldeci obnovia na plné (po finále nie).
sk.p18:
Cigarety po bitke — porazený dostane 1 cigaretu (pri sekere a po finále nikto), Kmotor (kto má jeho priazeň, tomu prejdú 2 / 3 / 4 priznané Dlhy k súperovi), Fajčiar (cigarety po bitke) a

výpalné

(po finále nie), potom sa spália karty, s ktorými sa stretol Krokodíl.
sk.p19: Návrat kariet do odhadzovacieho balíčka hráča, ktorý ich zahral; podložený Nástroj tomu, kto ho podložil.
sk.p20: Cintorín — porazený v bitke o Cintorín si smie vziať do ruky 1 kartu zo svojho odhadzovacieho balíčka, už aj z práve odohranej línie.
sk.p21: Kliatby z ruky — nepriznaná Cirhóza a Absťák idú do odhadzovacieho balíčka.
sk.p22: Chuť a Absťák — menej nerestí, než je tvoja Chuť, = karta Absťák; potom Chuť klesne o 1 od väčšieho z Chuti a nerestí (po finále už nie).
sk.p23: Nové kolo — každý si dobere 2 karty, nech má v ruke koľkokoľvek; poldeci má plné už z bitky. Limit ruky nie je a nič sa neodhadzuje.

starsi.skratka.1: Each player has their own 0–3 thermometer at each elder: the solid part is their fear, the hatching is the opponent's rumours.
starsi.skratka.2: Favour goes to whoever the elder fears less; its strength is the difference in fear, rumours don't count.
starsi.skratka.3: Notches are worth 1 / 2 / 3: the winner of the brawl gets their fear minus the notches taken, and both always get what they've taken with rumours.
starsi.skratka.4: The winner of the brawl raises fear with the Thrashing; the winner of the argument raises rumours. A notch costs 1 / 2 / 3; fear onto a taken notch costs 1 more.
starsi.skratka.5: For each of your red fears your opponent gives you a cigarette after the brawl (protection money). An elder in the red may be captured.
starsi.p1:
At the start of the game each

elder

gets a random favour, which you can see next to them. Each player has their own thermometer at each elder, with notches 0–3: grey, yellow, orange, red. The solid part is

fear

; the hatching in the opponent's colour is their

rumours

. How high the fear is tells you what the elder is to you: calm (0), uneasy (1), scared (2) or terrified (3).
starsi.p2: Fear is raised by the winner of the brawl with the Thrashing and never drops. For favour, victory by fear, capture and protection money it counts in full, even if the opponent has put rumours on it.
starsi.p3: Rumours are raised by the winner of the argument and lie on the opponent's thermometer: you take notches from the top of their fear downwards, then above it; from grey, from the bottom up. When the opponent raises fear onto a taken notch, they pay 1 more; when their fear passes the rumours, the rumours move up with it and the bottom notch disappears. Whoever lost the argument has their rumours drop from the bottom after scoring.
starsi.p4:
Favour

goes to whoever the elder fears less: strength = opponent's fear − your fear. On equal fear nobody has it. When you raise your fear you earn butts, but you hand your opponent favour. After the brawl each notch is worth yellow 1, orange 2, red 3 and goes to whoever holds it: the winner of the brawl for their fear minus the notches taken, and both, in every brawl, for the notches they've taken with rumours. Scoring goes by how things stood before raising; new fear scores only in the next brawl.
starsi.p5:
The

Thrashing

is the difference in hard damage. Step by step:
starsi.p6: The winner holds it and splits it (higher hard). On a tie on hard there's no Thrashing.
starsi.p7: It raises their own fear, among the elders as they like. A notch costs 1 into yellow, 2 into orange, 3 into red — 6 in all from grey to red.
starsi.p8: You split what you can: no remainder may be left that would still pay for another notch. Whatever can't go anywhere is forfeited and doesn't carry over.
starsi.p9: It comes only after the elders have scored, victory by fear and the bailiff's visit. For 5 points the winner may capture an elder where their fear was already in the red before this Thrashing.
starsi.p10: In the finale the Thrashing isn't split — the winner of the finale gets 1 butt for every point of it.
starsi.p11:
The

argument

(chapter Brawl) works the same way, only onto your rumours on the opponent's thermometer and at the same price; the winner of the argument with rumours over a whole thermometer may persuade that elder for 3 points. The argument doesn't change favours.
starsi.p12:
Straight after the brawl your opponent gives you 1 cigarette for every elder with your red fear — even if you lost the brawl, and on the Tab too. A

prisoner

counts as red; rumours don't. It's the fear after this brawl's Thrashing that counts, and your opponent gives as many as they have; what they don't have, they don't owe. You both pay at the same time, so protection money you receive can't be passed on in the same step. That way you've got cigarettes ready for the Market. Restriction doesn't cut protection money, it isn't a vice, and it isn't paid after the finale.
starsi.p13: A favour's strength is the difference in fear — 1, 2 or 3. Which favour an elder gives is dealt out at random at the start of the game; a prisoner gives no favour.
starsi.p22: That many of your Shakes don't count in the brawl (your hard doesn't drop for them and they don't count on a tie either)
starsi.p24: The bailiff takes that many fewer butts (Debts burn as always)
starsi.p26: Extra Work actions — they burn a confessed Debt, otherwise they give a butt
starsi.p28: Cigarettes after the brawl (Restriction doesn't cut them)
starsi.p30: After the brawl your confessed Debts pass over to your opponent's (with no Debt, nothing)
starsi.p32: Extra Superstitions in the argument; the opponent's Faith cancels them like Superstitions from cards
starsi.p33:
An elder with your red fear can be captured with the Thrashing after a won brawl. Enough

prisoners

for your division wins the game. An elder's card is a boss: 6 actions and one vice; in the line it has only actions, and only whoever holds it as a prisoner has its ability. It gets into a player's deck by persuasion.
starsi.p34: Victory by fear: whoever wins a brawl and after scoring has red fear at at least 4 elders (prisoners count) wins on the spot. A loser with four reds doesn't win.
starsi.p35: In the game you see it at every elder: two thermometers (yours and your opponent's), the solid part is fear and the hatching in the opponent's colour is their rumours; a ring shows who has the favour and how strong it is. The tooltip over an elder also shows the butts after the brawl and the risk of capture.

sk.skratka.1: Každý hráč má pri staršom svoj teplomer 0–3: plná časť je jeho strach, šrafa sú súperove reči.
sk.skratka.2: Priazeň má ten, koho sa starší bojí menej; sila je rozdiel strachov, reči sa nerátajú.
sk.skratka.3: Stupne majú hodnotu 1 / 2 / 3: víťaz bitky dostane strach bez obsadených stupňov, obaja vždy to, čo obsadili rečami.
sk.skratka.4: Strach dvíha víťaz bitky Nakladačkou, reči víťaz hádky. Stupeň stojí 1 / 2 / 3, strach na obsadený o 1 viac.
sk.skratka.5: Za každý tvoj červený strach ti súper po bitke dá cigaretu (výpalné). Staršieho na červenej smieš zajať.
sk.p1:
Každý

starší

dostane na začiatku hry náhodne svoju priazeň a vidíš ju pri ňom. Každý hráč má pri každom staršom vlastný teplomer so stupňami 0–3: sivá, žltá, oranžová, červená. Plná časť je

strach

, šrafa vo farbe súpera sú jeho

reči

. Výška strachu hovorí, aký je starší pre teba: pokojný (0), znepokojený (1), vystrašený (2) alebo vydesený (3).
sk.p2: Strach dvíha víťaz bitky Nakladačkou a neklesá. Do priazne, výhry strachom, zajatia a výpalného sa ráta celý, aj keď naň súper dal reči.
sk.p3: Reči dvíha víťaz hádky a ležia na teplomere súpera: obsadzuješ od vrchu jeho strachu nadol, potom nad neho, zo sivej zdola nahor. Keď súper dvíha strach na obsadený stupeň, platí o 1 viac; keď reči prekoná, posunú sa s ním a spodný stupeň zanikne. Kto prehral hádku, tomu reči po bodovaní klesnú zospodu.
sk.p4:
Priazeň

má ten, koho sa starší bojí menej: sila = strach súpera − tvoj strach. Pri rovnakom strachu ju nemá nikto. Keď si dvíhaš strach, zarábaš špaky, ale súperovi dávaš priazeň. Po bitke má každý stupeň hodnotu žltá 1, oranžová 2, červená 3 a dostane ho ten, kto ho drží: víťaz bitky za svoj strach bez obsadených stupňov, obaja pri každej bitke za stupne, ktoré obsadili rečami. Boduje sa podľa stavu pred zdvihnutím, nový strach boduje až v ďalšej bitke.
sk.p5:
Nakladačka

je rozdiel v tuhom poškodení. Krok za krokom:
sk.p6: Drží ju a rozdeľuje víťaz (vyššie tuhé). Pri remíze v tuhom Nakladačka nie je.
sk.p7: Dvíha svoj strach, ľubovoľne medzi starších. Stupeň stojí do žltej 1, do oranžovej 2, do červenej 3 — zo sivej na červenú spolu 6.
sk.p8: Rozdelí sa, čo sa dá: nesmie ostať zvyšok, ktorý by ešte stačil na ďalší stupeň. Čo už nikam nestačí, prepadne a neprenáša sa.
sk.p9: Príde to až po bodovaní starších, výhre strachom a exekúcii. Za 5 bodov smie víťaz zajať staršieho, pri ktorom má strach na červenej už pred touto Nakladačkou.
sk.p10: Vo finále sa Nakladačka nerozdeľuje — víťaz finále za ňu dostane 1 špak za každý bod.
sk.p11:
Hádka

(kapitola Bitka) ide rovnako, len na svoje reči na teplomere súpera a za rovnakú cenu; víťaz hádky s rečami na celom teplomere smie za 3 body presvedčiť staršieho. Priazne hádka nemení.
sk.p12:
Hneď po bitke ti súper dá 1 cigaretu za každého staršieho s tvojím červeným strachom — aj keď si bitku prehral a aj pri sekere.

Väzeň

sa ráta ako červená, reči nie. Ráta sa strach po Nakladačke tejto bitky a súper dá, koľko má; čo nemá, nedlhuje. Platíte obaja naraz, takže prijaté výpalné v tom istom kroku neodovzdáš ďalej. Cigarety máš tak pripravené na ponuku. Obmedzenie výpalné neuberá, nie je to nerest a po finále sa neplatí.
sk.p13: Sila priazne je rozdiel strachov — 1, 2 alebo 3. Akú priazeň starší dáva, sa mu rozdá náhodne na začiatku hry; väzeň priazeň nedáva.
sk.p22: V bitke sa ti neráta toľko Absťákov (tuhé za ne neklesne, nerátajú sa ani pri remíze)
sk.p24: Exekúcia ti vezme o toľko špakov menej (Dlhy zhoria ako vždy)
sk.p26: Akcie Robota navyše — spália priznaný Dlh, inak dajú špak
sk.p30: Po bitke prejdú tvoje priznané Dlhy medzi súperove (bez Dlhu nič)
sk.p32: Povery navyše v hádke; ruší ich súperova Viera ako Povery z kariet
sk.p33:
Starší s tvojím červeným strachom sa dá po vyhratej bitke Nakladačkou zajať. Dosť

väzňov

podľa ligy vyhráva hru. Karta staršieho je boss: 6 akcií a jedna neresť; v línii má len akcie, jeho schopnosť má len ten, kto ho drží ako väzňa. Do balíčka hráča sa dostane presvedčením.
sk.p34: Výhra strachom: kto vyhrá bitku a po bodovaní má červený strach aspoň u 4 starších (väzni sa rátajú), vyhráva hneď. Porazený so štyrmi červenými nevyhráva.
sk.p35: V hre to vidíš pri každom staršom: dva teplomery (tvoj a súperov), plná časť je strach a šrafa v súperovej farbe jeho reči; krúžok ukazuje, komu patrí priazeň a akú má silu. Nápoveda nad staršom ukáže aj špaky po bitke a riziko zajatia.

kliatby.skratka.1: Curses: Debt, Cirrhosis, the Shakes. A Debt is a counter, not a card — it's confessed at once. The Shakes can't be confessed.
kliatby.skratka.2: Confession lays a curse outside the line for good; it costs no shot.
kliatby.skratka.3: Only a Cirrhosis can be confessed — you don't draw a card for it.
kliatby.skratka.4: For confessed Debts the Bailiff turns up in every brawl: half the Debts burn, rounded up, and as many butts.
kliatby.skratka.5: An unconfessed Cirrhosis costs you 3 butts at the end of the game.
kliatby.p1:
Instead of playing a

curse

into the line, you can lay it in your play area — it's

confessed

and out of your deck for good. Confessing costs no shot and doesn't hand over the turn. A curse doesn't belong in the line.
kliatby.p2: Debt — not a card but a counter of confessed Debts: a new Debt (a Gamble action, a card effect) is confessed at once and you don't draw a card for it; it isn't drawn and can't be handled any other way. For confessed Debts the Bailiff turns up in every brawl, and on a tied brawl whoever has more of them loses.
kliatby.p3: Cirrhosis — goes to the discard pile; it comes into your hand only when the draw pile runs out and the discard pile is shuffled. You confess it whenever you like, but you don't draw a card for it. Confessed, it gives your opponent +1 hard in every brawl. Unconfessed, it goes to your discard pile after the brawl; at the end of the game it takes 3 butts off you (your hand and both piles count). Either you confess it straight away, or you risk it not coming back into your hand before the game ends.
kliatby.p4: The Shakes — a card that can't be confessed or played (chapter The price of drinking). After the brawl it goes back from your hand to the discard pile; each one in your deck takes 1 hard off you in the brawl, and whoever has more of them loses a tie. Only Vision may burn it.
kliatby.p5: The Loving Wife isn't a curse any more — she's a Citizen you lay in the line (where she lowers your liver in the Booze-up by 1).
kliatby.p6: Work: after damage, just before the bailiff's visit, for each active Work you burn 1 confessed Debt; for a Work with no Debt to burn, you get 1 butt. It goes player by player: the defender's Work and Bailiff, then the attacker's.
kliatby.p7:
Then the

Bailiff

turns up — in every brawl, after damage and the butts for the brawl (a tie and the Gambling Den still count your Debts), as long as you have at least one confessed Debt: half your confessed Debts burn (rounded up, even a single Debt) and as many butts. With the Lawyer's favour 1 / 2 / 3 fewer butts burn (Debts burn as always). Your opponent doesn't get them, and you may go below zero.
kliatby.p8: The Allotment Man in the line in your crew: the bailiff passes you by that round — nothing burns. Leftover Debts cost nothing at the end of the game.

sk.skratka.1: Kliatby: Dlh, Cirhóza, Absťák. Dlh je počítadlo, nie karta — je hneď priznaný. Absťák sa priznať nedá.
sk.skratka.2: Priznanie vyloží kliatbu natrvalo mimo línie; poldeci nestojí.
sk.skratka.3: Priznať sa dá len Cirhóza — kartu za ňu nedobereš.
sk.skratka.4: Za priznané Dlhy príde v každej bitke Exekútor: zhorí polovica Dlhov nahor a rovnako veľa špakov.
sk.skratka.5: Nepriznaná Cirhóza ťa na konci hry stojí 3 špaky.
sk.p1:
Kliatbu

môžeš namiesto do línie vyložiť do svojej hracej oblasti — je

priznaná

a natrvalo mimo balíčka. Priznanie nestojí poldeci ani neodovzdá ťah. Kliatba do línie nepatrí.
sk.p2: Dlh — nie je karta, ale počítadlo priznaných Dlhov: nový Dlh (akcia Hazard, efekt karty) je hneď priznaný a kartu zaň nedobereš; neťahá sa a nedá sa s ním inak manipulovať. Za priznané Dlhy príde v každej bitke Exekútor a pri remíze v bitke prehrá, kto ich má viac.
sk.p3: Cirhóza — ide do odhadzovacieho balíčka; do ruky príde, až keď sa doberací balíček minie a odhadzovací sa zamieša. Priznáš ju, keď chceš, ale kartu za ňu nedobereš. Priznaná dá súperovi v každej bitke +1 tuhé. Nepriznaná ide po bitke do tvojho odhadzovacieho balíčka; na konci hry ti zoberie 3 špaky (ráta sa ruka aj oba balíčky). Buď ju prizníš hneď, alebo riskuješ, že sa ti do konca hry nevráti do ruky.
sk.p4: Absťák — karta, ktorá sa nedá priznať ani vyložiť (kapitola Cena pitia). Po bitke sa z ruky vráti do odhadzovacieho balíčka; každý v tvojom balíčku ti v bitke uberie 1 tuhé a remízu prehrá, kto ich má viac. Spáliť ho smie len Vízia.
sk.p5: Milujúca manželka už kliatba nie je — je to Občan, ktorý sa kladie do línie (a tam ti zníži pečeň v Pitke o 1).
sk.p6: Robota: po poškodení, tesne pred exekúciou, spáliš za každú aktívnu Robotu 1 priznaný Dlh; za Dlh, ktorý nemá čo spáliť, dostaneš 1 špak. Ide sa po hráčoch: obranca Robota a Exekútor, potom útočník.
sk.p7:
Potom príde

Exekútor

— v každej bitke po poškodení a špakoch za bitku (remíza a Herňa tvoje Dlhy ešte spočítajú), kým máš aspoň jeden priznaný Dlh: zhorí ti polovica priznaných Dlhov (zaokrúhlené nahor, aj jediný Dlh) a rovnako veľa špakov. S priazňou Advokáta ti zhorí o 1 / 2 / 3 špaky menej (Dlhy zhoria ako vždy). Súper ich nedostane a smieš ísť do mínusu.
sk.p8: Záhradkár v línii v tvojej partii: exekúcia ťa v tom kole obíde — nezhorí nič. Zvyšné Dlhy na konci hry nestoja nič.

nastroje.skratka.1: A Tool isn't played into the line — you tuck it under your own Citizen or Elder in the line for 1 cigarette.
nastroje.skratka.2: It has a top and a bottom edge; the one sticking out from under the card counts.
nastroje.skratka.3: The edge retrains the card's action (X → Y), or gives it Overdrive, NA EX, a Hooligan or a Revolt.
nastroje.skratka.4: After the brawl the Tool goes back to the discard pile of whoever tucked it.
nastroje.skratka.5: Heirloom: a Tool's effect applies only there; the price is 1, 2, 3… cigarettes for both players together.
nastroje.p1:
A

Tool

doesn't have actions down its sides like other cards. It has a top and a bottom edge, both in the card's colour, and in the middle an illustration and the Heirloom text. Each edge does one of three things:
nastroje.p2: Retraining X → Y — all X actions on the card the Tool lies under count as Y (Punch → Wallop: two Punches are two Wallops). It applies before links are made, so neighbours already pair with the retrained action. If the card has no X action, the Tool under it does nothing.
nastroje.p3: Boosted X — X actions on the card are boosted ×2 as with Boost (Rifle, Trap, Wheelbarrow, Horoscope, Duct Tape). It's the ones active after NA EX that count: inactive X activated by a NA EX get ×4.
nastroje.p4:
Effect on the whole card — the Energy Drink gives it

Overdrive

(all actions active after NA EX ×2), Plonk a

NA EX

(no shot — nobody drinks, no liver and no vice), the Injection makes it a

Hooligan

and the Pitchfork flips it with a

Revolt

. On their other edge these four have a retraining.
nastroje.p5: You may only tuck a Tool under your own card, which is why the edges improve the card they lie under — or help depending on what lies next to it.
nastroje.p6:
In the Assembly you

tuck

a Tool from your hand under a card tagged Citizen or Elder in the line — only under your own, not under your opponent's — for 1 cigarette.
